title: Knowledge-grounded customer support
description: Two-step retrieval-augmented generation is a documented pattern for FAQ and documentation bots. Retrieve relevant policy or product passages before drafting customer answers. Human review is a separate design decision for uncertain or consequential responses.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation and semantic search
description: Retrieval brings external knowledge into model context. A two-step RAG flow retrieves relevant passages before generating an answer; embedding models and vector stores support semantic search. Suitable reference for document questions and support knowledge assistants.

title: Document intelligence and extraction
description: Document intelligence extracts text, tables and structured fields from documents. Prebuilt and custom extraction models support document processing. Extraction results require validation before use in business workflows.

title: Supervised machine learning
description: Supervised learning includes classification and regression methods such as linear models, support vector machines and decision trees. These methods learn relationships from labeled examples for prediction tasks.

title: Time-series forecasting and evaluation
description: Lagged features can support forecasting with regression models. Time-aware evaluation avoids the overly optimistic estimates that random train-test splits can produce for time-series data.

title: Workflows and agentic AI
description: Workflows follow predetermined code paths, while agents dynamically decide their processes and tool usage. Patterns include routing, parallel work and orchestrator-worker designs; choose according to task flexibility and predictability needs.

title: Human-in-the-loop review
description: Human review can interrupt proposed tool actions and let a reviewer approve, edit or reject them. Review policies and persisted execution state support oversight of consequential actions.

title: Container deployment and health checks
description: Render Blueprints describe service runtime, environment variables and health-check paths in YAML. Environment-specific configuration and health checks support deployment of an API service.
